questions.q: Which sensor is the main one for stabilization?
questions.explain: The gyro provides angular rate thousands of times a second — the whole stabilization loop runs on it.

questions.q: Why is the compass mounted on a mast together with the GPS?
options: Away from the field of the power wires
To pick up GPS satellites better together
So it doesn't get in the way of the props
questions.explain: The compass measures the Earth's magnetic field; the current in the power wires creates its own field and distorts the heading.

questions.q: How does F4 differ from F7 when connecting SBUS?
options: F7 cannot do SBUS without an adapter
questions.explain: The STM32F4 cannot invert a UART input in software, so SBUS on it works only through a hardware inverter on a dedicated pad.

questions.q: Why is the barometer covered with foam?
questions.explain: Airflow and sunlight distort the pressure. The foam smooths it — the baro altitude stops jumping.

options: TX to RX, RX to TX, GND
TX to TX, RX to RX and a common positive
questions.explain: The transmitter of one side goes to the receiver of the other. Without a common GND the signal has no reference level.

questions.q: The model in the configurator rotates the wrong way. What do you do?
questions.explain: If the board is mounted rotated, the firmware needs to be told about it — with the orientation parameter.

questions.q: Why doesn't an SBUS receiver work on an arbitrary UART of an F405?
questions.explain: F4 has no software inversion — you need a port with a hardware inverter; F7/H7 invert any port.
A UART emulated on GPIO: up to 19200, loads the CPU — for SmartAudio and non-critical things, not for the receiver.
